Method of Attack: Injecting scripts into commonly used web tools such as cloud analytics plug-ins, content management systems, and online support snippets to steal data entered into online payment forms or login pages on eCommerce sites.
Attack Vector: Digital skimming via third-party web tools
Indicators of Compromise: Ticketmaster site targeted via third-party supplier Inventa, card-skimming malware capturing payment card data and sending it to a remote command and control server.
